description: Workshop field dictionary. Map types and validation to the chosen destination before integration.

fields.item_id: Your local unique identifier; use a source-event key for deduplication when available.
fields.source_url: Primary source URL. Retain linked-document URL separately if needed.
fields.source_identifier: NCT, appraisal, event, document, or other source identifier.
fields.source_event_date: Date of the underlying event stated by the source; unknown if not stated.
fields.source_publication_date: Date the source published or updated this information; preserve precision.
fields.before_capture_date: Actual time the earlier version was captured; unknown when no earlier capture exists.
fields.after_capture_date: Actual time the later version was captured; unknown when none exists.
fields.retrieved_at: Actual time the analyst retrieved the source; distinct from capture and publication dates.
fields.evidence_reference: File/version/URL plus section supporting the old and new values.
fields.changed_field: Exact field or content that changed.
fields.old_value: Earlier published value, with units and estimated/actual qualifiers.
fields.new_value: Later published value, with units and estimated/actual qualifiers.
fields.team_rule: Observable condition chosen by the team.
fields.important: Proposed classification under the team rule: true, false, or null when evidence is insufficient.
fields.needs_review: True when source evidence is missing, ambiguous, or conflicting; retain for human review regardless of importance.
fields.owner: Named person or role responsible for source review.
fields.destination: Approved queue or mailbox; use placeholders in public examples.
fields.due_at: Review deadline selected by the team.
fields.review_status: Unreviewed, reviewed, needs source, or no action.
fields.action: Decision or next action, including no action with a reason.
fields.observed_at: Time recorded for detection of the saved change event, distinct from publication, capture and email arrival.
fields.ai_summary: Saved platform AI Summary, if supplied, quoted or attributed separately from verified source observations.
fields.saved_important: Saved platform IMPORTANT value: true, false, or null if not supplied. Do not overwrite it with a proposed rule result.
fields.classification_provenance: Identify saved platform output versus analyst/AI proposal, with the rule and evidence used.
fields.evidence_basis: Direct comparison, visible highlighted content, AI-reported change, or unresolved; specify per claim when mixed.
fields.delivery_policy: Every captured edit or IMPORTANT-only delivery, explicitly selected by the team.
fields.maintenance_owner: Person responsible for source coverage, moved/new pages and failed monitors.
